step-1.text: Clear the floor where the bed will live and lay the parts out on the empty box. This frame is held together by its joints, so put the screwdriver away.

count-1.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

step-2.text: Stand two corner legs up, slots facing each other. Lower the head rail so its tongues slide down into the slots, both ends together, until the top is flush with the legs.

count-2.text: This step uses 2 corner legs and 1 head and foot rail.

step-3.text: Same again at the foot end: two legs, then the foot rail slides down into their slots.

count-3.text: This step uses 2 corner legs and 1 head and foot rail.

step-4.text: Set the two ends a bed length apart. Lift a side rail and lower its tongues into the open slots at the head and the foot at the same time, then press down until it sits flush. One person at each end makes this easy. If a joint is tight, press with your palm, never hammer.

step-5.text: Drop the center rail into the notches in the middle of the head and foot rails, and stand its two legs straight so they touch the floor. Then turn the two hand-tightened screws in with your fingers until snug.

count-5.text: This step uses 1 center rail and 2 hand-tightened screws.

step-6.text: Press down on each corner. Every rail should sit flush with the top of its legs, with no gap in any slot. Measure corner to corner both ways: when the diagonals match, the frame is square.

count-6.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

step-7.text: Unroll the slats from the head to the foot. Seat the ends on the ledges inside the side rails so they lock in place and cannot slide. Eighteen slats, evenly spaced.

step-8.text: Push the bed into place, check that nothing rocks, and lay the mattress on. No box spring needed.

count-8.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

done.text: Done. Your CLASSIC BED bed frame, full is built. Give it a proud little pat.
